lines.text: Hi, Ben. Are you free on Saturday?
lines.speaker: Mia

lines.text: Let's go to the park at two.
lines.speaker: Mia

lines.text: Sorry, I can't get there before three.
lines.speaker: Ben

lines.text: Three is fine. Meet at the west gate?
lines.speaker: Mia

lines.text: Could you say that again? Which gate?
lines.speaker: Ben

lines.text: The west gate, next to the bus stop.
lines.speaker: Mia

lines.text: OK. See you there at three on Saturday.
lines.speaker: Ben
